newsitem.title: USA: CLISA sells $100 mln 144A snr guaranteed notes.
newsitem.headline: CLISA sells $100 mln 144A snr guaranteed notes.

text.p: The following debt issue from Compania Latinoamericano Infraestructura Servicios SA (CLISA) was priced on Wednesday in the 144A private placement market, according to sole manager Citicorp Securities Inc.
The notes are guaranteed by Benito Roggio E Hijos SA and Caminos Australes SA.
CLISA is a private Argentine infrastructure and construction company.
BORROWER Compania Latinoamericano Infraestructura Servicios SA
TYPE SNR GTD NOTES ISS PRICE 100.00 FIRST PAY DATE 12/1/1997 LAST MOODY'S N/R YIELD 11.625 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL

NOTE: THE NOTES HAVE A THREE-YEAR EQUITY CALL FOR $25 MILLION AT 111.625.
